topic.instructions: Which department of a large online store should handle state.message? Pick the one whose work the message is mainly about.

criteria.customer_service: An order already placed: where it is, delivery problems, a late, missing, wrong or damaged item, cancelling an order, a return or a refund, a price drop after buying, or an item bought here that broke or stopped working (warranty).
criteria.billing: Charges and payments: an unexpected or double charge, payment methods, invoices or receipts, gift card balances, a membership or subscription fee.
criteria.marketing: A product before buying it: features, sizes, compatibility, availability, prices, promotions, deals, coupons, newsletters, reviews.
criteria.tech_support: The website or app not working: signing in, password resets, error messages, or a digital service (e-books, streaming, smart home) failing. Not a physical item that broke: that is a warranty claim, Customer Service's.
criteria.trust_safety: Fraud and safety: scams, phishing, a hacked or stolen account, counterfeit or dangerous products, reporting a seller or buyer.
criteria.hr: Working here: a job application, careers, internships, interviews, employment verification.
criteria.seller_services: Selling on the marketplace: opening a seller account, listings, seller fees, payouts to sellers, fulfillment for sellers.
criteria.procurement: Supplying the company: a supplier, manufacturer or brand that wants to sell its goods to us wholesale, or a vendor's invoice.
criteria.business_sales: Buying for a company: bulk or corporate orders, business accounts, quotes, tax-exempt purchasing.
criteria.legal: Legal and privacy matters: legal notices, subpoenas, copyright or trademark claims, data-protection or privacy requests (access, deletion).
criteria.press: The media: journalists, interview or comment requests, press releases.
criteria.investor_relations: Investors: shares, earnings, annual reports, shareholder meetings.
criteria.other: Anything that fits none of the above, or a message too vague to tell.

urgent_probability.instructions: Is state.message urgent: a safety risk, a security breach in progress, money taken wrongly, or a deadline within the next 24 hours?

criteria.true: The message describes a safety risk, an ongoing security breach, money wrongly taken, or a deadline within 24 hours.
criteria.false: Nothing in the message needs action within 24 hours.

sensitive_data_probability.instructions: Does state.message itself contain a full payment card number, a password, a bank account number or a government ID number?

criteria.true: The message includes at least one such number or password written out.
criteria.false: The message includes none; mentioning a card or an account without its number doesn't count.

abusive_probability.instructions: Is state.message abusive, threatening or harassing toward the company or its staff?

criteria.true: The message threatens, harasses or insults people.
criteria.false: The message is civil, even if it complains firmly.

request_kind.instructions: If state.message is about an order, what does the customer want done? Pick none when it isn't about an order.

criteria.where_is_order: To know where an order is, or to report that it is late or hasn't arrived.
criteria.return_refund: To return an item or get their money back for it, without saying it is damaged or defective.
criteria.damaged_defective: Something about an item that arrived damaged, broken or wrong, or that stopped working.
criteria.price_adjustment: The price dropped after they bought it, and they want the difference back.
criteria.duplicate_charge: They were charged twice, or more than they should have been, for an order.
criteria.none: Anything else, including messages that aren't about an order.

decision.name: Contact Hub · Route a request to a department

topic.desc: aityx's choice: which department's work the message is mainly about

topic_confidence.desc: aityx's confidence in its choice of topic

urgent_probability.desc: aityx probability: is the message urgent?

sensitive_data_probability.desc: aityx probability: does the message contain a card number, password, bank account or ID number?

abusive_probability.desc: aityx probability: is the message abusive, threatening or harassing?

request_kind.desc: aityx's choice: what the customer wants done with their order

today.desc: Today's date, when the request arrived

order.desc: The order the message names, from the order book: when it was placed and delivered (or is expected), what was paid and what it costs today, its category and status, and how many times it was charged. Status none when the message names no known order.
order.from: the order book, by the order number in the message

evidence_threshold.desc: Minimum probability that establishes a fact about the message

confidence_threshold.desc: Minimum confidence in the topic to route it without a person triaging it

sensitive_data.desc: Does the message contain a card number, password, bank account or ID number?

abusive.desc: Is the message abusive, threatening or harassing?

clear_topic.desc: Is the topic one department's, with enough confidence to route it directly?

department.desc: The department that handles the request

table.why: Abusive or threatening messages go to Trust & Safety, whatever they are about.
The topic is unclear or fits no department, so General Inquiries triages it.
Orders, deliveries, returns and refunds are Customer Service's.
Charges, payment methods, invoices and gift cards are Billing & Payments'.
Questions about products, prices and promotions before buying are Marketing's.
Problems with the website, the app, sign-in or devices are Technical Support's.
Fraud, scams, hacked accounts and counterfeit goods are Trust & Safety's.
Job applications and careers are Human Resources'.
Selling on the marketplace is Seller Services'.
Suppliers and vendors who sell to the company are Procurement's.
Bulk and corporate purchases are Business Sales'.
Legal notices, intellectual-property claims and privacy requests are Legal & Privacy's.
Journalists and media requests are Public Relations'.
Shareholders and financial results are Investor Relations'.
Nothing more specific applies, so General Inquiries triages it.

return_window_days.desc: Days after delivery for a refund

credit_window_days.desc: Days after delivery for store credit, once the refund window has passed

damage_window_days.desc: Days after delivery to report damage for a replacement or refund

warranty_days.desc: Days of warranty on electronics, from delivery

price_match_days.desc: Days after ordering in which a price drop is refunded

late_after_days.desc: Days after ordering after which an undelivered order is late

manual_review_above.desc: Refunds above this amount, in USD, are approved by a person

restocking_fee_rate.desc: Restocking fee on electronics returned after the restocking-free days

restocking_free_days.desc: Days after delivery in which electronics return without a restocking fee

refund_processing_days.desc: Days to pay a refund or credit, from today

has_order.desc: Does the message name an order on file?

days_since_order.desc: Days from placing the order to today

days_since_delivery.desc: Days from delivery to today; -1 when not delivered

within_warranty.desc: Electronics delivered at most warranty_days ago?
within_warranty.expr: delivered and order.category = "electronics" and days_since_delivery <= warranty_days

within_price_match.desc: Ordered at most price_match_days ago, and cheaper now?

late.desc: Shipped, and not delivered late_after_days after ordering?

charged_twice.desc: Was the order charged more than once?

restocking_fee_applies.desc: Electronics returned after the restocking-free days?

resolution.desc: What the store's policy offers for the order

table.why: The message isn't about an order: no order policy applies.
The message names no order on file: ask for the order number before anything else.
The order hasn't shipped: cancel it and refund it in full.
The order has already shipped and can't be cancelled: it can be returned once it arrives.
Still not delivered more than 10 days after ordering: open a carrier investigation and offer a replacement.
The order is on schedule: share its tracking.
The order was charged more than once: refund the duplicate charge.
The order book shows a single charge: Billing checks the statement with the customer.
The price dropped within 14 days of ordering: refund the difference.
Price drops are refunded only within 14 days of ordering.
Damage reported within 7 days of delivery: replace it or refund it in full, the customer's choice.
Electronics within their 1-year warranty: repair or replace under warranty.
The order hasn't been delivered yet: it can be returned once it arrives.
Final-sale items can't be returned.
Refunds above $500 are approved by a person.
Returned within 30 days of delivery: refund to the original payment method.
Past the 30-day refund window but within 60 days: store credit for the full amount.
More than 60 days after delivery: past the return policy.
No order policy applies.

refund_amount.desc: Money refunded or credited, in USD
table: The difference between what was paid and today's price.
The amount paid, less the 15% restocking fee on electronics returned after 14 days.

refund_by.desc: The date by which the refund or credit is paid

priority.desc: How soon the department must answer

table.why: Abuse and threats are reviewed the same day.
Card numbers, passwords and ID numbers must be removed from the message quickly.
The message describes a safety risk, a breach, money wrongly taken or a deadline within 24 hours.
A late package: the customer is waiting, and a replacement may be needed.
Fraud, security and legal matters run on short deadlines.
Questions that aren't about an order or an account can wait two days.
A regular request: answered within a working day.

response_hours.desc: Hours the department has to answer
table: High priority is answered within 4 hours.
Normal priority is answered within a working day.
Low priority is answered within two days.

needs_review.desc: Should a person check the message before the department works on it?
needs_review.expr: not(clear_topic) or sensitive_data or abusive or resolution = "manual_review"
